meta.title: BI Developer
meta.tagline: Transform raw data into actionable business intelligence.
meta.description: BI developers design and build data warehouses, ETL pipelines, reports and dashboards that enable organizations to make data-driven decisions. They combine data engineering with visualization to create self-service analytics platforms.
certifications: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst
